visual_notes: Both full images and every margin read. Enlarged reference12, faisans/faisons, the corrected ending, all dense cancellations, preschéma overprint, the short mark over dans, f(F/T), the oval/index glyphs and the fused s/x word. Every insertion bracket was followed to its attachment; unsupported literal parentheses were removed while separate quotation marks were retained.
